Project-authored MIT PE32 fixture; rebuild with `npm run build:owner-lists`.

`npm run test:owner-lists` uploads the unchanged executable in Chromium. Native fixed/variable owner-drawn lists exercise measurement, raw-data sorting, Unicode strings, item geometry, height updates, real clipped HDC drawing, selection/focus/disabled state and deletion/reset/destruction callbacks. Browser pixels and input verify the displayed behavior. Multi-selection, owner-drawn combo popups, horizontal/multicolumn lists and universal GUI compatibility remain incomplete.
